title: Curry
summary: curry(fn) lets a function's required arguments be supplied over successive calls, each call able to supply multiple arguments; invokes fn once enough arguments have accumulated and returns its result, otherwise returns a function accepting more arguments.
outputFormat: fn result when arity reached; otherwise a function
